posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body:

note: I can play my own projects
Another question is whether I can use the resources from this game in my own projects and distribute them for free and commercially?

posts.body: Or open Game.ini and replace 2 with a 4. If that fails, open Game.rxproj with Notepad and repeat the same process.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body: I've never heard of Knight Blade, but unless it explicitly says in the ReadMe that the resources are available for use: no, you cannot use the resources from a published game. It's known as "ripping," and it isn't allowed here.
